claim: A sector sliding across a room engulfs whatever stands in its path and carries it along on a perfectly good floor until it reaches a wall, where it is crushed: 'can a body stand there' is not 'is a body safe there'. A switch whose standing place lies in the swept area kills the player who uses it.
evidence: Seen in a headless bot run on AGTST18 (2026-08-27): channel 112 drove a slide door (sector 70) and the room it sweeps (sector 87); the bot pressed it from a stance 57 units short of the wall's sector with a 192-wide body and died.
use: Put every control of a sweeping mover outside the area it sweeps, with a body's width to spare.
